records.jp: それで、どうしたの、美弦さん？
records.en_original: Is something up, Mio?
records.en_auxiliary: Is something up, Mio?
records.en: Is something up, Mio-san?

records.jp: ちょっと質問したいことがあるのだけど……<CR>いろいろと聞いてもいいかしら？
records.en_original: I had a few questions I wanted to ask you... Do you mind?
records.en_auxiliary: I had a few questions I wanted to ask you... Do you mind?
records.en: I have a few questions...<CR>May I ask you about some things?

records.jp: きっと陽桜莉は、こういうの得意じゃないだろうから。<CR>せめて私だけでも、正確に状況を把握しておきたくて
records.en_original: I know Hiori isn't the type to worry about this kind of thing, so I want to make sure I fully grasp the situation.
records.en_auxiliary: I know Hiori isn't the type to worry about this kind of thing, so I want to make sure I fully grasp the situation.
records.en: Hiori probably isn't good with this sort of thing.<CR>At the very least, I want to understand our situation accurately.

records.jp: うん、もちろん。<CR>私に答えられる範囲で、だけど
records.en_original: Sure, go ahead. I can only answer what I know, though.
records.en_auxiliary: Sure, go ahead. I can only answer what I know, though.
records.en: Sure, go ahead.<CR>I can only answer what I know, though.

records.jp: 前、聞いた話だと……あなたは最初から<CR>元の世界の記憶を持っているのよね？
records.en_original: From what I've heard, you have had the memories of the other world from the beginning, correct?
records.en_auxiliary: From what I've heard, you have had the memories of the other world from the beginning, correct?
records.en: From what I heard before... you had your memories of<CR>the original world from the very beginning, correct?

records.jp: うん。昔のことはちゃんと覚えてる……はずだよ
records.en_original: Yeah, I remember all of it... I think.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I remember all of it... I think.
records.en: Yeah, I remember all of it... I think.

records.jp: そういう風に最初から記憶を持っていたのは<CR>他には誰もいないのよね？
records.en_original: That wasn't the case for anyone else, isn't that right?
records.en_auxiliary: That wasn't the case for anyone else, isn't that right?
records.en: And no one else had their memories from<CR>the beginning like that, correct?

records.jp: そう、だね。私だけ、最初から記憶がある状態だった
records.en_original: Right. I was the only one who had my memories intact.
records.en_auxiliary: Right. I was the only one who had my memories intact.
records.en: Right. I was the only one who had my memories intact.

records.jp: なら、やっぱり愛央だけ<CR>何か他とは違うものがある気がするわね……
records.en_original: Then there must be something different about you.
records.en_auxiliary: Then there must be something different about you.
records.en: Then there must be<CR>something different about you.

records.jp: ちなみに、今はみんな記憶を取り戻せているの？
records.en_original: And has everyone recovered their memory?
records.en_auxiliary: And has everyone recovered their memory?
records.en: By the way, has everyone recovered their memories now?

records.jp: ああ、いや。勇希がまだだよ
records.en_original: Not yet. Yuki still hasn't.
records.en_auxiliary: Not yet. Yuki still hasn't.
records.en: Not yet. Yuki still hasn't.

records.jp: どうして？
records.en_original: Why is that?
records.en_auxiliary: Why is that?
records.en: Why is that?

records.jp: んー、特に理由はないんじゃないかな？<CR>単純に、まだその時が来ていないだけで……
records.en_original: Hmm... I don't know if there is a reason. Maybe it's just not time for her to remember yet.
records.en_auxiliary: Hmm... I don't know if there is a reason. Maybe it's just not time for her to remember yet.
records.en: Hmm, I don't think there's any particular reason.<CR>It simply may not be time for her yet...

records.jp: （でも、言われてみれば遅い、かも……？）
records.en_original: (Though now that I think about it, it does seem like it's been a long time...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Though now that I think about it, it does seem like it's been a long time...)
records.en: (Though now that I think about it, it does seem like it's been a long time...)

records.jp: なら、やっぱり愛央だけが<CR>私たちと何か違う、ということね
records.en_original: Then there is no doubt that there is something different about you.
records.en_auxiliary: Then there is no doubt that there is something different about you.
records.en: Then it does seem that you alone<CR>are somehow different from the rest of us.

records.jp: 平和な世界の記憶を持っている、<CR>というのも少し引っかかるし……
records.en_original: I can't help but wonder why your memories are of a peaceful world...
records.en_auxiliary: I can't help but wonder why your memories are of a peaceful world...
records.en: I can't help but wonder why your<CR>memories are of a peaceful world...

records.jp: も、もしかして私の記憶って、<CR>偽物だったりするのかな……？
records.en_original: D-do you think my memories are fake...?
records.en_auxiliary: D-do you think my memories are fake...?
records.en: D-do you think my<CR>memories are fake...?

records.jp: どうかしらね……
records.en_original: I wonder...
records.en_auxiliary: I wonder...
records.en: I wonder...

records.jp: 変だということは間違いないけど、<CR>ならなぜ愛央だけがそうなっているのかが分からないわ
records.en_original: It is certainly odd. Why would you be the only one with fake memories?
records.en_auxiliary: It is certainly odd. Why would you be the only one with fake memories?
records.en: It is certainly strange,<CR>but I don't understand why you alone would be that way.

records.jp: そうだよね……
records.en_original: Yeah...
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah...
records.en: Yeah...

records.jp: 愛央、何か思い当たる節はない？<CR>身近に変なことが起きたとか……
records.en_original: Do you have any idea why this could be, Ao? Anything strange that you've noticed?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you have any idea why this could be, Ao? Anything strange that you've noticed?
records.en: Ao, does anything come to mind?<CR>Did anything strange happen around you...?

records.jp: うーーーん……
records.en_original: Hmmmm...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmmmm...
records.en: Hmmmm...

records.jp: （あの日、私は補習を受けに学校に行って……<CR>気がついたら、この世界にいた）
records.en_original: (That day, I came to the school for summer classes and ended up here in this world...)
records.en_auxiliary: (That day, I came to the school for summer classes and ended up here in this world...)
records.en: (That day, I went to school for a make-up class...<CR>and when I came to, I was in this world.)

records.jp: （変わったことと言えば、スマホを落として<CR>イタズラされたことくらい……）
records.en_original: (The only unusual thing that happened that day was dropping my phone and seeing that weird message...)
records.en_auxiliary: (The only unusual thing that happened that day was dropping my phone and seeing that weird message...)
records.en: (The only unusual thing was dropping my phone and having<CR>someone play a prank on me with it...)

records.jp: うまれかわれ
records.en_original: Be Reborn
records.en_auxiliary: Be Reborn
records.en: Be Reborn

records.jp: （まさかあれがきっかけ？<CR>いや、だとしてもどうやって……）
records.en_original: (Could that be it? No, then how would—)
records.en_auxiliary: (Could that be it? No, then how would—)
records.en: (Could that have been the trigger?<CR>No, even if it was, how...?)

records.jp: ……どう？
records.en_original: Well...?
records.en_auxiliary: Well...?
records.en: Well...?

records.jp: あ……ううん。<CR>やっぱり、心当たりはない……かな
records.en_original: Oh, uh...no. I can't really think of anything...
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, uh...no. I can't really think of anything...
records.en: Oh, uh...no.<CR>I can't really think of anything...

records.jp: そう……
records.en_original: I see...
records.en_auxiliary: I see...
records.en: I see...

records.jp: ……一つ、荒唐無稽なことを考えていたのだけど
records.en_original: I do have one theory... Though it's a stretch.
records.en_auxiliary: I do have one theory... Though it's a stretch.
records.en: ...I was considering one rather far-fetched possibility.

records.jp: ……愛央は、過去から来たんじゃないかしら
records.en_original: Could it be that you came from the past, Ao?
records.en_auxiliary: Could it be that you came from the past, Ao?
records.en: Could it be that you came from the past, Ao?

records.jp: か、過去……？
records.en_original: Th-the past?
records.en_auxiliary: Th-the past?
records.en: Th-the past?

records.jp: あなたの記憶が本物だとしたら、<CR>もう「別の時間から来た」くらいしか考えられなかった
records.en_original: If your memories are real, then it would make sense if you came from a different time.
records.en_auxiliary: If your memories are real, then it would make sense if you came from a different time.
records.en: If your memories are real, the only<CR>explanation I could think of was that you came from another time.

records.jp: 何者かが、時空を超えて<CR>愛央をこの世界に送り込んだ……？
records.en_original: Could somebody have traveled through time and brought you to here?
records.en_auxiliary: Could somebody have traveled through time and brought you to here?
records.en: Did someone send Ao across<CR>space and time into this world...?

records.jp: 何者かって……。<CR>誰が、いったい何のために？
records.en_original: But who would do that? And why?
records.en_auxiliary: But who would do that? And why?
records.en: But who would do that?<CR>And why?

records.jp: 自然に考えれば……<CR>崩壊した未来を救うため、ということになるかしら
records.en_original: One would naturally assume that it was to save the future.
records.en_auxiliary: One would naturally assume that it was to save the future.
records.en: The natural conclusion would be...<CR>to save a future that had already collapsed.

records.jp: まだ灰が降っていない時代に生きていた愛央を<CR>この世界に連れてきて、何かしようとした……
records.en_original: There must be something they wanted you to accomplish by bringing you here from a time before the Ash.
records.en_auxiliary: There must be something they wanted you to accomplish by bringing you here from a time before the Ash.
records.en: There must be something they wanted you to accomplish<CR>by bringing you here from a time before the Ash.

records.jp: それって……
records.en_original: But that's...
records.en_auxiliary: But that's...
records.en: But that's...

records.jp: …………ごめんなさい、やっぱり突飛すぎるわね
records.en_original: ...I'm sorry. I went too far. We don't know if any of this is true.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I'm sorry. I went too far. We don't know if any of this is true.
records.en: ...I am sorry. That really was too far-fetched.

records.jp: でも、これだけは言える。<CR>あなたは、他のみんなとは違う
records.en_original: But it's important we recognize that you are the odd one out.
records.en_auxiliary: But it's important we recognize that you are the odd one out.
records.en: But I can say this much.<CR>You are different from everyone else.

records.jp: 愛央……あなたが鍵を握っているかもしれない
records.en_original: I believe you hold the key to solving everything.
records.en_auxiliary: I believe you hold the key to solving everything.
records.en: Ao... You may be the one who holds the key.

records.jp: 私が……
おーい！　お話終わった～？
records.en_original: Hey, are you two done yet?
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, are you two done yet?
records.en: Hey, are you two done yet?

records.jp: わ、どうしたの？
records.en_original: Oh! What's going on?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh! What's going on?
records.en: Oh! What's going on?

records.jp: どうしたのじゃない！<CR>またリフレクターを呼ぶんでしょ？
records.en_original: You know exactly what's going on! We have to summon that last Reflector!
records.en_auxiliary: You know exactly what's going on! We have to summon that last Reflector!
records.en: What do you mean, what's going on?!<CR>We're calling another Reflector, right?

records.jp: だったら、学校魔改造計画だよ！
records.en_original: Which means it's time for our next school makeover!
records.en_auxiliary: Which means it's time for our next school makeover!
records.en: Then it's time for the radical school makeover plan!

records.jp: が、学校魔改造計画？
records.en_original: A-a school what?
records.en_auxiliary: A-a school what?
records.en: A-a school what?

records.jp: 来て、美弦！<CR>新しく来た人のフレッシュなアイデアが欲しいの！
records.en_original: Come with me, Mio! We could use a fresh perspective!
records.en_auxiliary: Come with me, Mio! We could use a fresh perspective!
records.en: Come on, Mio!<CR>We need some fresh ideas from the newest arrival!

records.jp: えっ？　えっ？
records.en_original: What? Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: What? Huh?
records.en: What? Huh?

records.jp: ふふ。ちょうど今、美弦さんの<CR>フレッシュなアイデアを聞いてたとこだよ
records.en_original: Hehe, she was just sharing her fresh perspective with me.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, she was just sharing her fresh perspective with me.
records.en: Hehe. I was just hearing<CR>some of Mio-san's fresh ideas.

records.jp: あはは、忙しいな……
records.en_original: Hahaha, she's as busy as always.
records.en_auxiliary: Hahaha, she's as busy as always.
records.en: Ahaha, things sure are busy...

records.jp: ……私が鍵を握ってるかも、か。<CR>そんなこと言われても、なあ
records.en_original: I'm the key to everything...? What am I supposed to do with that...
records.en_auxiliary: I'm the key to everything...? What am I supposed to do with that...
records.en: ...I might hold the key, huh? Even if she says<CR>that, I don't know what to do with it.

records.jp: ……私に何ができるんだろう
records.en_original: What can I possibly do?
records.en_auxiliary: What can I possibly do?
records.en: What can I possibly do?
